Hanno Ecotourism Association: https://hanno-tourism.jp/hanno-eco/tour/ec-kitagawa-kawanina/

As part of the Agano Headwater Firefly Revival Project, this program conducts a habitat survey of freshwater snails (kawanina), which are food for Genji fireflies, and environmental improvement work.

【Participation Fee】
Adult: ¥1,500 per person
Elementary school age and under: ¥1,000 per person
(Includes instructor fee, insurance, facility use, etc.)

【Capacity】30 people

【Guide】Tsubasa Kojima (Hanno City Ecotourism Citizens Guide Association, Wildlife Group)

【What to Bring】Work gloves, hat, change of clothes, water bottle, clothes that are okay to get wet, marine shoes (sandals and rubber boots prohibited). *If you have them: box magnifying glass, water net, collection case, etc.

【Notes】For more information, see Kitagawa Camping Base website: http://www.kitagawa-cb.jp/
